tools.name: read_x_post
tools.description: Reads a public X (Twitter) post and returns it as Markdown: author, date, engagement, text, images, video links, polls, quoted post, and the FULL body of X Articles (long-form posts). Use it whenever the user shares an x.com or twitter.com status link. Does not return replies or full multi-post thre

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_x_post · Public sink: read_x_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_x_post · Public sink: read_x_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
